prompt: Create a vertical cinematic surreal photograph of a lone young woman seen from behind, standing in a vast dark green grassy field under enormous storm clouds. She wears a long pale off-white vintage dress with long sleeves, her dark hair loose down her back, small in the frame and positioned slightly left of center. Far ahead to the right stands a single freestanding wooden doorway or doorframe, upright in the open field, engulfed in bright orange flames along the frame and top edge, casting a small warm glow on the grass. The scene contains exactly two main subjects: the woman and the burning doorway. Use a low horizon so the sky dominates most of the image, filled with towering soft cumulus storm clouds in blue-gray and cream tones, moody overcast light, distant flat horizon, no buildings or trees. Style it like an imperfect analog film still: muted teal-green color grading, visible grain, slight haze, soft focus, subtle dust specks and photographic artifacts, natural lens perspective, dramatic contrast between cold cloudy sky and warm firelight. Vertical 2:3 composition, melancholic and mysterious magical-realism atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张竖构图的电影感超现实主义摄影作品，画面中一名孤独的 年轻女子 背对着镜头，站在广阔的深绿色草地上，头顶是巨大的风暴云。她穿着一件长袖的浅 米白色 复古长裙，深色长发披散在背上，在画面中显得很小，位于中心偏左的位置。前方右侧远处矗立着一扇独立的木制门或门框，竖立在开阔的田野上，门框和顶部边缘被明亮的橙色火焰吞没，在草地上投射出微弱的暖光。场景中仅有两个主体：女子和燃烧的门框。使用低地平线构图，使天空占据画面大部分空间，天空中充满了蓝灰色和奶油色的高耸积雨云，光线阴郁，远处地平线平坦，没有建筑物或树木。风格模仿不完美的胶片剧照：柔和的青绿色调，可见的颗粒感，轻微的朦胧感，柔焦效果，细微的灰尘斑点和摄影伪影，自然的镜头透视，冷色调云层与暖色调火光形成戏剧性的对比。2:3 竖构图，忧郁而神秘的魔幻现实主义氛围，无文字，无水印。
